# Kaiord

> Kaiord gathers an athlete's training and health data from the platforms
> where it is scattered. It comes as two products: the Kaiord App, a browser
> application to plan, build and send workouts, with no account; and the
> Kaiord SDK, TypeScript libraries, a CLI and an MCP server for the FIT, TCX,
> ZWO and Garmin Connect workout formats. MIT licensed, by Pablo Albaladejo.

Key facts:

- The Kaiord App is free, needs no sign-up, and stores its data in the
  browser (IndexedDB). Data leaves the device only to destinations the
  athlete sets up: the AI provider whose key they enter, the platforms they
  connect through browser extensions, intervals.icu to check the API key they
  add for it, and their own Google Drive if they turn on sync. Separately,
  every page loads Umami analytics, which records anonymous page views and
  product events, never workouts, health data or keys. Kaiord keeps no
  accounts and stores no user data on its servers.
- The Kaiord SDK converts workout files between FIT, TCX, ZWO and GCN
  (Garmin Connect) through KRD, the SDK's internal canonical model.
- A CLI (`kaiord convert`) and an MCP server (`@kaiord/mcp`) expose the same
  conversion pipeline to scripts and AI agents.

## Product

- [Landing page](https://kaiord.com/): product overview in English
- [Landing page (Spanish)](https://kaiord.com/es/): product overview in Spanish
- [Kaiord App](https://kaiord.com/app/): the browser application — training
  calendar, workout builder, assistant with your own key, sending to Garmin
  Connect
- [Kaiord for Garmin (Chrome extension)](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/kaiord-garmin-bridge/innelncjhkdokailkinkchppgekennoe):
  lets the Kaiord App send workouts to Garmin Connect and read your
  activities, using your own Garmin sign-in

## Guides for athletes

- [Plan your training with AI using your own API key](https://kaiord.com/docs/guide/ai-planning-byok):
  the in-browser assistant with your own Anthropic, OpenAI or Google key
- [WHOOP recovery in your training plan](https://kaiord.com/docs/guide/whoop-recovery-in-plan):
  recovery, HRV and sleep next to your planned workouts
- [Kaiord vs TrainingPeaks, intervals.icu and Garmin Connect](https://kaiord.com/docs/guide/kaiord-vs-trainingpeaks-intervals-garmin):
  a sourced comparison of price, workout builder, sending workouts to Garmin and data
- [Guías en español](https://kaiord.com/docs/es/): the same three guides in
  Spanish
- [Planifica tu entrenamiento con IA y tu propia clave de API](https://kaiord.com/docs/es/guide/ai-planning-byok):
  Spanish version of the AI planning guide
- [La recuperación de WHOOP en tu plan de entrenamiento](https://kaiord.com/docs/es/guide/whoop-recovery-in-plan):
  Spanish version of the WHOOP recovery guide
- [Kaiord frente a TrainingPeaks, intervals.icu y Garmin Connect](https://kaiord.com/docs/es/guide/kaiord-vs-trainingpeaks-intervals-garmin):
  Spanish version of the comparison

## Documentation

- [Docs home](https://kaiord.com/docs/): guides, format specs, API reference
- [Quick start](https://kaiord.com/docs/guide/quick-start.md): convert a FIT
  file to TCX in TypeScript
- [Converters](https://kaiord.com/docs/convert/): how to convert workout files
  between FIT, TCX, ZWO, and Garmin Connect (with per-pair fidelity notes)
- [Why Kaiord?](https://kaiord.com/docs/guide/why-kaiord.md): one SDK for
  every workout file format
- [KRD format](https://kaiord.com/docs/formats/krd.md): the SDK's internal
  canonical model, which every conversion goes through
- [MCP tools](https://kaiord.com/docs/mcp/tools.md): use Kaiord tools from
  AI assistants via the Model Context Protocol
- [Docs index for LLMs](https://kaiord.com/docs/llms.txt): per-page markdown
  mirrors of every docs page
- [Full docs corpus](https://kaiord.com/docs/llms-full.txt): the entire
  documentation as a single markdown file

## Source & packages

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/pablo-albaladejo/kaiord): monorepo
  with the Kaiord SDK and the Kaiord App
- [npm packages](https://www.npmjs.com/org/kaiord): @kaiord/core, @kaiord/fit,
  @kaiord/tcx, @kaiord/zwo, @kaiord/garmin, @kaiord/cli, @kaiord/mcp
